segments.name: Oncology
products: AVMAPKI FAKZYNJA CO-PACK (avutometinib capsules; defactinib tablets)
segments.description: A biopharmaceutical company developing and commercializing medicines for patients with RAS/MAPK pathway-driven cancers.
segments.evidence: Verastem Oncology (Nasdaq: VSTM), a biopharmaceutical company committed to advancing new medicines for patients with RAS/MAPK pathway-driven cancers, today reported financial results for the three months and full year ended December 31, 2025, and highlighted recent progress.

revenueModel.text: The company earns net product revenue from U.S. sales of AVMAPKI FAKZYNJA CO-PACK to treat KRAS-mutated recurrent LGSOC, plus occasional license and milestone payments.
revenueModel.evidence: AVMAPKI FAKZYNJA CO-PACK generated net product revenues of $17.5 million for the fourth quarter of 2025 and $30.9 million for the full year 2025, following accelerated U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval in May 2025

changes.text: In 2025, the company began commercial sales of AVMAPKI FAKZYNJA CO-PACK following FDA approval in May 2025.
changes.evidence: The Company began commercial sales of the AVMAPKI FAKZYNJA CO-PACK within the U.S. following receipt of FDA approval in May 2025.
